# response-format-enforcer

> Validate LLM replies as CSV with typed columns, read-only SQLite SELECT statements or a full-match regex, and re-ask with a bounded correction loop Python package `trysac-response-format-enforcer`, import name `response_format_enforcer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
